1.he: כי ירדו עם אלה או עם אלה עד לחיים
1.note: phrase as printed; sense: they did not pursue either group to the point of taking their lives

2.note: print unclear; read as מזכיות, 'on the merits of' (the Beatitudes)

3.note: The saying on keeping and teaching the commandments is Matt. 5:19; reference kept as printed.

4.note: The abbreviation מ"ס (an edition or commentary?) is unclear; rendered literally.

5.note: Name as printed (סאנטא); transliterated as it stands, identity not checked.

6.note: Read as הופסה (from הפיס דעת, 'appeased'), as with הפסת דעת on the next page.

7.note: Idiom of Kiddushin 28a: the insulted man may harm the other's livelihood.

8.note: The saying is Tobit 4:15; the chapter figure in the scan reads ו' (or ד'), kept as printed.

9.note: Serving not to receive a reward is Avot 1:3; kept as printed.

10.note: The saying is Eduyot 5:7; kept as printed.

11.note: In Matthew the saying is 23:12 (cf. 18:4); kept as printed.

12.note: The parable is in Yerushalmi Berakhot 2:8; the scan reads פ"ג.

13.note: Printed ברעתנו; read בדעתנו, 'as we know'.

14.note: Second word blurred in the scan; read בזמנו.

15.note: Abbreviation unclear in the scan; read as Musaf he-Arukh.

16.note: Mishnah Megillah has four chapters; kept as printed.

17.note: Name as printed (סאנטא); transliterated as it stands, identity not checked.

18.note: Folio figures unclear in the scan; his saying on thief and robber is at Bava Kamma 79b.

19.note: name damaged in the print (only א-פנה-ים legible); read as Oppenheim
